lens: Skeptic at matched physical scale. New q15 camera (1.55 m, pitch -0.26) re-matched to y_47300: back tops y 222-225 vs 231-233, pillows 425-495 vs 420-490, seat centres within 5 px, so photo and render boxes now coincide for backs / covers / pillows / pad wings; pan boxes moved to the belt-free front band (render y 550-573 vs photo 505-560, the render's belts and buckles cover the photo box) - pan numbers are therefore a little less like-for-like than the backs. st.py stats (mean RGB, Rec.709 luma L, B/R, G/R, p10/50/90, p90/p10, p90/50, coverage > 1.4x median, blob mean, hpCV sigma 3); cover extents by low-variance flood fill; armrest bright-run widths per row (arm.py) and dark-run widths across the pan joints; arm colour boxes; studio close-ups e4 / e4b vs y_47306 (tick guard) and r29s vs r30s side-by-sides.
